about_short_description.short_description: Saif Check offers AI risk assessments for compliance & security, risk mitigation and certification for AI projects.

product.name: GRC Tools
product.description: A governance, risk, and compliance tool designed for AI systems, covering international and industrial regulatory frameworks.

product.name: Data & Model Quality Assessment
product.description: Audits data and AI models to evaluate quality and provide specific mitigation steps for identified issues.

product.name: AI Cybersecurity
product.description: Provides protection against adversarial attacks on AI systems with implementable guardrails and observability.

product.name: Multi-Agent AI Systems Risk Mitigation
product.description: Risk mitigation and guardrail implementation for multi-agent AI systems with comprehensive observability.

product.name: Governance Risk Assessments
product.description: Conducts risk assessments aligned with various governance frameworks and AI regulations to ensure compliance.

product.name: Model Quality & Cybersecurity Assessments
product.description: Assesses AI model quality and cybersecurity aspects including responsible AI, data quality, and specific domain safety concerns.
